class.name: SteamHttpResponseResult
class.brief_description: Terminal transport outcome for a Steam HTTP request.
class.description: A successful result contains the complete response, including responses with 4xx or 5xx status codes. Failed or cancelled requests have no response value. Read [member SteamResult.message] for the rejected request setting, transport failure, response limit, or cancellation reason.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Return the complete HTTP response, or [code]null[/code] if the request failed.

members.member: Complete response after successful transport. The value is [code]null[/code] on failure.
